name: What is a failure-to-diagnose medical malpractice claim?

mainEntity.name: What is a failure-to-diagnose medical malpractice claim?

acceptedAnswer.text: A failure-to-diagnose medical malpractice claim arises when a healthcare professional's negligence leads to a delayed or incorrect diagnosis, causing harm to the patient. This can occur if a doctor fails to order appropriate tests, misinterprets test results, overlooks obvious symptoms, or does not refer the patient to a specialist when necessary. The key is proving that another competent medical professional, acting under similar circumstances, would have made the correct diagnosis in a timely manner.
acceptedAnswer.description: A failure-to-diagnose claim involves harm caused by a healthcare professional's negligent delay or error in diagnosis.
